movesets.name: Nasty Plot
movesets.description:
Delphox casts a spell on PU as an effective sweeper and wallbreaker, having a plethora of good matchups thanks to its high power and relatively high Speed tier. At +2, Fire Blast is able to 2HKO Assault Vest Galarian Slowbro, OHKO Bronzong, and even OHKO Bellibolt after Stealth Rock. While Flamethrower can be more consistent in terms of accuracy, its lower damage output will often lead to Delphox missing important benchmarks. Psyshock gives Delphox a way to reliably damage frailer foes that resist Fire Blast such as Salazzle as well as an option to muscle through special walls such as Florges. It also provides a reliable option to damage Pokemon that may not be hit super effectively by Delphox's other coverage moves, such as Tatsugiri and Coalossal, as well as a way to secure KOs in cases where Fire Blast missing would result in a sticky situation. Delphox's last moveslot is adjustable; Encore allows Delphox to lock foes into undesirable moves like Gastrodon's Stealth Rock and Scrafty's Bulk Up and generate setup opportunities. Grass Knot is a reliable coverage option against bulky Ground-types that may not crumble to a Fire Blast such as Gastrodon, Mudsdale, and Golurk, while Dazzling Gleam deals consistent damage to Bulk Up Paldean Tauros-W and lets Delphox beat Scrafty without prior chip damage. Tera Fairy provides Delphox with a resistance to Dark and prevents it from being revenge killed by Sucker Punch users such as Skuntank and Bombirdier while also removing other problematic weaknesses to Water, Ground, and Ghost and boosting the power of Dazzling Gleam.

Delphox is rather frail, so it needs teammates that can pivot it in safely such as Milotic, Rotom-C, and Gligar. Spikes setters such as Alolan Sandslash and Coalossal can help Delphox to secure damage benchmarks more easily, lessening the number of opportunities Fire Blast has to miss and helping to break through Scream Tail and Arcanine. Sticky Web support from Vikavolt is also valued, allowing Delphox to remedy its sometimes awkward Speed tier. Pokemon that can discourage or absorb Knock Off, like Virizion and Scrafty, also make good partners, as Delphox largely relies on Heavy-Duty Boots to find opportunities to switch in. Checks to Decidueye, such as Ambipom and Bombirdier, are also highly valued, as Delphox is 2HKOed by a Spell Tag-boosted Shadow Sneak. Decidueye itself, alongside Pokemon like Paldean Tauros-W and Scrafty, are also valuable for their ability to take on a myriad of other foes that can threaten Delphox offensively, such as Golurk and Zoroark. Faster revenge killers like Kilowattrel and Salazzle are also threatening, so Pokemon with priority moves like Sucker Punch Zoroark, Aqua Jet Paldean Tauros-W, and Shadow Sneak Decidueye make excellent partners. Choice Scarf users such as Duraludon, Staraptor, and Flamigo can also fulfill this role. In return, Delphox can blow holes in the opposing team, allowing these Pokemon to clean up once their checks have been weakened.

strategies.overview:
Psychic

Delphox suffers from not having the best stats overall, it's not as fast nor as powerful as one would like out of an offensive powerhouse for Psychic, being just barely slower than Iron Treads and struggling to break threats like Ting-Lu and Araquanid. However, if these threats can be dealt with for Delphox, its Speed tier is just good enough to get the jump on the rest of the relevant Steel- and Bug-types in the tier and check them with its Fire-type STAB moves before they become a problem for its teammates.

movesets.name: Nasty Plot (Psychic)
movesets.description:
Delphox manages to find a place on Psychic teams because of its respectable base 104 Speed and access to Nasty Plot enabling it to eliminate the likes of Corviknight, Heatran, and Scizor, which otherwise prove huge problems for Psychic teams. Fire Blast and Flamethrower melt through problematic Steel- and Ice-types such as Gholdengo, Scizor, and Articuno, with Fire Blast being preferred for its ability to OHKO specially defensive Articuno at +2. After a boost, Focus Blast enables Delphox to handle the likes of Heatran, Hydreigon, and Empoleon. Finally, Delphox has a solid movepool to pull from for coverage and utility options. Encore can allow Delphox to lock the likes of Bisharp and Moltres into moves such as Sucker Punch and Roost, enabling it to set up on them. Alternatively, at +2, Grass Knot eliminates the likes of Swampert, Hippowdon, and Mamoswine, while Psyshock deals with special walls such as Blissey and Assault Vest Tornadus-T.

Delphox greatly appreciates the support of physical attackers like Iron Boulder and Gallade that help break through the Dark-types and special walls it struggles hard against like Ting-Lu, Alolan Muk, and Hisuian Goodra. Choice Scarf Iron Boulder also deals with faster threats such as Choice Scarf Kleavor and Meowscarada, whereas Assault Vest Gallade can come in on special attackers such as Darkrai and Greninja while being able to use Sacred Sword to deal with Garganacl and Blissey comfortably. Choice Specs Latios appreciates Delphox dealing with Steel-types like Scizor and Gholdengo and, in return, it can use its powerful Draco Meteor to beat Dragon-types such as Raging Bolt and Walking Wake for Delphox. Latios is also able to check Ground-types such as Gliscor and Landorus formes with its Levitate ability and Ice Beam. Slowbro provides a Water-type resistance that enables it to come in on the likes of Urshifu-R and Barraskewda, while its high Defense can help it check physical attackers such as Iron Treads and Dragonite. Slowbro also provides Thunder Wave support to slow down threats like Tornadus-T and Choice Scarf Archaludon, enabling Delphox to remove them. Hatterene helps to check opposing Dark- and Dragon-types such as Meowscarada, Roaring Moon, and Latios and greatly appreciates Delphox removing Steel-types like Corviknight for it. Metagross can set Stealth Rock to wear down would-be checks like Alolan Muk and Ogerpon-W, along with using Bullet Punch to pick off faster targets such as Flutter Mane and Weavile for Delphox. Assault Vest Hoopa-U is capable of handling threats like Choice Scarf Gholdengo, Spectrier, and Primarina with options like Knock Off and Thunderbolt.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 6 onwards

Price Range: 6-7 points

Overview: On paper, Delphox has quite a few things going for it, with a strong STAB combination and a decent Speed tier to help accomplish burning down foes in its path with its good Special Attack stat. Delphox also has a few utility options such as Will-O-Wisp and Encore to support its team. Sadly, Delphox is very frail and not fast or strong enough to overcome this weakness, leaving it prone to getting revenge killed. It is also very weak to common offensive types like Dark and Ground, so it struggles finding opportunities to switch in. Finally, Delphox is weak to entry hazards, which is very detrimental because it prefers running offensive items instead of Heavy-Duty Boots.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Revenge Killer: Delphox can excel as a revenge killer by using a Choice Scarf to pick off weakened foes, surprise faster threats, or ruin a defensive foe's capabilities with Trick when it can enter the field safely.

Wallbreaker: Against slower teams, Delphox can act as a wallbreaker with either Choice Specs or other damage-boosting items for an immediate burst in power to whittle down foes and support its team.

Setup Sweeper: With access to moves such as Nasty Plot, Calm Mind, and Agility, Delphox can act as a setup sweeper to clean through weakened teams if it finds the right opportunity to do so. Due to its fragility, this set requires a lot of support from Delphox's teammates to make it work, such as needing specific foes to be weakened first.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Fire Blast, Flamethrower, Overheat, Psychic, Psyshock, Psychic Noise

Setup Moves: Nasty Plot, Calm Mind, Agility, Flame Charge

Utility Moves: Will-O-Wisp, Trick, Switcheroo, Encore

Coverage: Shadow Ball, Grass Knot, Dazzling Gleam, Focus Blast, Tera Blast, Scorching Sands

Niche Moves

Hex: Delphox can use Hex if its paired with Will-O-Wisp or status-inflicting teammates in order to deal more damage to problematic foes.

Future Sight: Delphox can use Future Sight as a means to help its team break defensive switch-ins that otherwise make it hard for Delphox to break through foes.

Mystical Fire: On bulkier sets, Delphox can make use of Mystical Fire to slow down opposing Special Attackers and give it more opportunities to deal damage.

Endure: Endure can be used alongside Salac or Petaya Berry to boost Delphox's Speed or Special Attack whilst activating Blaze to elevate its wallbreaking power.

Reflect / Light Screen: Delphox can use Reflect and Light Screen in an emergency to give its teammates more opportunities to set up.

Common Items

Choice Scarf: Choice Scarf allows Delphox to get the jump on faster foes and guarantee damage on them. It can also use Trick or Switcheroo to ruin setup sweepers or defensive foes that may try to tank its hits.

Choice Specs: Delphox can use Choice Specs to scorch foes with massive damage and break through defensive pieces. While Choice Specs makes Delphox incredibly powerful, it also makes it easier for foes to revenge kill Delphox.

Heavy-Duty Boots: Heavy-Duty Boots allows Delphox to enter the field more safely if Stealth Rock is up and find more opportunities to set up and stay healthy.

Niche Items

Other Damage-boosting Items: Items such as Life Orb, Charcoal, and Twisted Spoon can give Delphox more power to break through foes if it doesn't need to equip a Choice Scarf. It can also use Expert Belt if it expects to go up against multiple foes that Delphox can hit with its decent coverage.

Eject Pack: Delphox can use Eject Pack in conjunction with Overheat to act as a one-time pivot for a teammate that can finish a foe after it has taken massive damage. By using its item this way, Delphox can also steal a foe's item the next time it comes in with Magician.

Focus Sash: Delphox can bait offensive foes that expect to KO it with a strong attack and fire back a Will-O-Wisp or strong attack in return.

Assault Vest: Delphox has decent special bulk and coverage, so an Assault Vest can increase its Special Defense further to sponge hits against specially offensive foes in a pinch.

Tera

Delphox appreciates being your secondary Tera Captain of choice when no others are suitable so that it can utilize its strengths and patch up its mediocre defensive typing. Tera Fairy is its best defensive typing to flip its matchup against Dark-types, resist Sucker Punch, and boost Dazzling Gleam's power. Tera Water, Fighting, and Ground are also generally good options to hit problematic foes with Tera Blast.

Draft Strategy

Delphox should be drafted as a secondary offensive option to keep up pressure alongside faster teammates and bulky walls. Its frailty and weakness to Stealth Rock mean that it often struggles to find the best opportunities to switch in, and it needs support from its teammates to help in this regard.

Entry Hazard Control: Delphox's glaring weakness to Stealth Rock and frailty mean that it needs help from teammates to keep hazards off the field. Pokemon such as Great Tusk, Terapagos, and Excadrill are good teammates to consider.

Slow Pivots: Delphox often needs to be shown the way onto the battlefield by its teammates, as it struggles to do so on its own. It would appreciate Pokemon such as Alomomola, Corviknight, and Milotic that can pivot to Delphox safely.

Dark-types: Delphox appreciates Dark-type Pokemon such as Zarude, Ting-Lu, and Roaring Moon, as they can switch into attacks aimed at Delphox and resist Sucker Punch and Shadow Sneak.

Faster Teammates: Delphox's Speed is good, but it needs faster teammates such as Greninja, Sneasler and Darkrai so that it is not forced to use Choice Scarf in every match.

Checks and Counters

Entry Hazards: Delphox is very vulnerable to hazards, especially Stealth Rock, as it prefers to not run Heavy-Duty Boots, which limits how often it can switch in.

Priority and Faster Foes: Delphox is weak to common priority attacks such as Aqua Jet, Shadow Sneak, and Sucker Punch, which means it is prone to being revenge killed if it is weakened enough, which does not take too much effort due to its poor physical bulk. It can also struggle to deal with faster foes that can revenge kill it easily, forcing it to run Choice Scarf if it wants to get the jump on these foes first.

Offensive Dark-types: Dark-types such as Meowscarada, Greninja, and Weavile can use their STAB attacks to revenge kill Delphox. Dark-types are also very prevalent in the metagame, which makes it hard to fit Delphox on a team.

Bulky Water-types: While Delphox has access to Grass Knot, it still struggles to deal with bulky Water-types such as Primarina, Tentacruel, and Empoleon that can easily set up against Delphox or cripple it with status.
